result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to build a handoff tracker tailored for small software development teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Investigation of weekly handoff friction, update documentation, and workflow transitions within small software teams in Latvia.
- Identification of functional requirements for task handoff tracking, strictly excluding payroll or financial advice features.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Oversees development sprint workflows and cross-developer or dev-to-QA handoffs in small software teams.

- How many hours per week does your team spend consolidating and relaying handoff updates across roles? (question-108c7b8e128359bf1623fb0b)
- What existing tracking tools do you use, and what prevents them from automating your weekly status handoffs? (question-c09d1a00b987ec748a9fc45b)

## Product Owner

Coordinates task readiness, feature specifications, and acceptance criteria between stakeholders and development.

- Where do handoff miscommunications or manual tracking bottlenecks most commonly occur during release cycles? (question-bd2cd7744687284598e9b0fa)
- What criteria would determine whether your organization adopts a standalone handoff tracking tool? (question-866d1373e541295b83ef3cd0)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software engineering teams in Latvia experience recurring manual overhead when formatting or copying status updates.
- Dedicated handoff tracking functionality can offer measurable productivity gains beyond standard board and issue tracker features.

## Evidence gaps

- No market data exists regarding software development team sizes and prevailing tool adoption across Latvian technology companies.
- Lack of verified customer discovery interviews confirming whether manual Friday handoffs are widespread across the region.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
